title: Six Countries on One HR Platform
summary: Reading Time: < 1 min SRKK, a leading IT consultancy, faced inefficiencies with their previous HRMS, prompting a shift to BrioHR. Chief Strategy Officer Alex Lam highlights BrioHR's user-friendly interface and efficiency improvements in payroll, claims, and leave management. This transition has streamlined operations, reduced administrative burdens, and empowered staff, contributing to overall business success. The post Six Countries on One HR Platform appeared first on BrioHR .
